create_pca_embedding: create PCA-reduced embeddings from high-dimensional feature tensors with configurable component count
project_embedding_to_rgb: project high-dimensional image embeddings to RGB color images using PCA or random projection
project_embedding_to_3d_color: project high-dimensional point cloud embeddings to 3D RGB colors using PCA or random projection
calculate_principal_components: calculate principal components from embedding features using SVD decomposition
calculate_prototypes_from_labels: calculate prototype vectors as normalized mean embeddings grouped by label
